source: vendor BFD dump ('bfd.dumpbfd), parsed by xist.bfd
note: Complete routing fuse map for every 29-row routing tile type (centre, 48-column CIB, 59-column edge/PIC).  Tile types with identical maps share a profile.  Bit coordinates use column_base from SL2-12E_bitcol_base.json; PLC (48-col) and tile columns 1/49 (59-col) are measured, the rest follow the same row/column rule.
